findings.title: Preserve range-variable detection before interpolation
findings.body: This interpolates each expression before `querySupportsSplitting` checks it, so a query containing `$__range` (or another range variable recognized by `isQueryWithRangeVariable`) can lose the marker that prevents time splitting. The query is then executed over smaller time partitions even though its range-dependent expression was resolved for the original range, producing incorrect results. Check splitting eligibility on the original expression or otherwise preserve the range-variable information before interpolation.
